title: ENG-205 Sir Gawain Part 2 — 3 Numbers & Dates
subject: ENG-205

cards.def: Fitt III runs three paired days of outdoor hunt and indoor temptation before Gawain leaves for the Green Chapel.

cards.term: Day 1: deer hunt and one kiss
cards.def: On the first day Bertilak hunts deer (hinds and does) while Lady Bertilak wins one kiss from Gawain, which Gawain returns that evening.

cards.term: Day 2: boar hunt and two kisses
cards.def: On the second day Bertilak kills a huge wild boar while Lady Bertilak wins two kisses, which Gawain courteously returns in exchange.

cards.term: Day 3: fox hunt and three kisses plus girdle
cards.def: On the third day Bertilak takes a fox while Lady Bertilak wins three kisses and the secret green girdle, and Gawain returns only the three kisses.
Gawain hugs Bertilak and kisses him in the comeliest way he could, calling it his one profit under the pact.
Gawain catches Bertilak by the neck and courteously kisses him, then a second time kisses him in a similar style, saying now we're even.
Gawain clasps Bertilak tight and kisses him three times with as much emotion as a man could muster, but does not hand over the girdle.
After the second exchange Bertilak keeps Gawain one more night, swearing Gawain will find the Green Chapel long before dawn on New Year's Day.

cards.term: "I have tested you twice and found you truthful"
cards.def: Bertilak tells Gawain this after two honest trades of winnings (deer for one kiss, boar for two), right before saying "third time throw best," meaning the third try turns out best.
Gawain praises the first day's deer haul as the hugest he has seen this seven years in the winter season.
On the first morning the bugles blow three long, bare notes to start the hounds and open the deer hunt.
